units.source_text: 大导寺信辅出生在本所的回向院附近。

en.t: Daidoji Shinsuke was born near Ekoin Temple in Honjo.

units.source_text: 在他脑海的记忆力，哪里没有一条称得上美丽的街道，

en.t: In his memory, there was not a single street that could be called beautiful,

units.source_text: 也没有一所称得上漂亮的房子。

en.t: nor was there a single house that could be called handsome.

units.source_text: 尤其是在他家附近，都是一些制作地下木柜洗澡桶的木匠、粗点心铺子、旧家具店之类的。

en.t: Especially near his home, there were only carpenters who made underfloor cupboards and bath tubs, cheap sweet shops, secondhand furniture stores, and the like.

units.source_text: 这些店铺前面的道路，常年都是泥泞不堪，

en.t: The road in front of these shops was muddy all year round,
and it had never once been dry and clean.

units.source_text: 再加上这条道路的尽头就是御竹仓的大水沟——一条河面上飘着浮萍大水沟，

en.t: Moreover, at the end of that road lay the great ditch of O-Takegura, a great ditch with duckweed floating on its surface,
which gave off a foul smell throughout the year.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，他对这种街道没办法不感到压抑。

en.t: There was no doubt that he could not help feeling oppressed by such streets.

units.source_text: 但是，本所之外的其他街道更让人他觉得不快。

en.t: But the streets outside Honjo felt even more unpleasant to him.

units.source_text: 上从以住宅为主的山手区开始，

en.t: From the residential Yamate district above,

units.source_text: 下到以从江户时代流传下来的、鳞次栉比的整洁店铺为主的下町一代，

en.t: down to the Shitamachi area with its neat rows of shops handed down from the Edo period,
they all made him feel still more depressed.

units.source_text: 和本乡、日本桥相比，他对寂静的本所更加热爱——

en.t: Compared with Hongo and Nihonbashi, he loved quiet Honjo all the more,

units.source_text: 更热爱回向院、驹止桥、横网、排水渠、榛木马场、御竹仓的大水沟。

en.t: and loved even more Ekoin, Komadome Bridge, Yokoami, the drainage channels, Hanoki Baba, and the great ditch of O-Takegura.

units.source_text: 与其说是热爱，毋宁说是近似同情怜悯的一种情感吧。

en.t: Rather than love, it was probably a feeling closer to sympathy and pity.

units.source_text: 但是，就算是同情怜悯也罢！

en.t: But even if it was sympathy and pity, so be it!

units.source_text: 一直到三十年后的现在，也只有那些地方让他魂牵梦绕……

en.t: Even now, thirty years later, only those places still haunted his soul and dreams...
